body: Large language model agents have shown promise in bioinformatics, but most existing systems focus primarily on producing final answers, treating planning, tool use, and code execution as transient interactions. This design is poorly suited to long-horizon bioinformatics tasks, where conclusions must remain connected to the data, computations, and intermediate evidence that support them. We introduce Bioinfoysis, a multi-agent harness that represents each request as a persistent, artifact-grounded analysis run. Bioinfoysis combines global planning with step-wise, evidence-driven replanning: the planner maintains an executable checklist and revises pending steps using structured handoffs returned after each worker execution. These handoffs bind intermediate results to their responsible agent, checklist step, and plan generation, preventing stale evidence from being silently reused after replanning. A controlled runtime validates generated scripts, tables, and figures before they are used in downstream analysis or reporting, while role-specific context, persistent memory, and governed bioinformatics skills support reliable execution over long analysis trajectories. We evaluate Bioinfoysis on BixBench and two question-answering tracks of LAB-Bench 2. On BixBench, Bioinfoysis achieves state-of-the-art accuracy of 82.4%. Across four underlying language models, Bioinfoysis increases average accuracy from 27.81% to 64.13% on SeqQA2 and from 3.13% to 31.25% on DbQA2. These results demonstrate that reliable bioinformatics automation depends not only on model capability, but also on the harness that governs planning, execution, memory, and evidence flow. We hope that the emergence of Bioinfoysis will play a driving and leading role in the development of the bioinformatics community. Our demo website can be seen in https://report.bioinfoysis.com/.
summaryZh: 本文介绍了Bioinfoysis，一个面向长期生物信息学任务的多代理运行框架。该框架将每个请求表示为持久且带有工件锚定的分析运行，通过全局规划与逐步、证据驱动的重新规划，确保中间结论与计算结果的连贯性。实验证明该 harness 大幅提升了底层大模型在生信基准上的准确率。

glossary.explanationZh: 生物信息学，利用计算工具和模型对生物学数据（如基因序列）进行分析的学科。
多代理运行框架，用于协调多个专业代理协同执行复杂多步骤任务的控制系统。
长周期任务，需要跨越许多步骤、长时间规划和中间状态跟踪的复杂执行流程。
结构化交接，代理之间传递中间计算结果和状态的标准格式，防止信息丢失或失真。
